newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT shares hit 39-mo high in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: NTT shares hit 39-mo high in afternoon.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp's share price hit one million yen in Tuesday afternoon trade, the first time it has reached that level since February 1994, brokers said.
By 0400 GMT, the shares had retraced to 995,000 yen, up 25,000 yen from the close on Friday, before the three-day weekend.

"Foreign investor buying is leading it to the one million yen level, buoyed by recent news that the shares will be included in the Morgan Stanley Capital International Japan index," a broker at a mid-sized brokerage said.
